overview.name: Innovator Growth-100 Power Buffer ETF - August
overview.description: The fund has adopted a policy pursuant to Rule 35d-1 under the 1940 Act to invest, under normal circumstances, at least 80% of its net assets in investments that provide exposure to the Invesco QQQ TrustSM, Series 1 (the “Underlying ETF”). The fund is non-diversified.
